name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the agent to reach the exit, but no hard goal clause is provided to make it happen; the machine has no FINAL_STATES. Add a hard Existence(at_exit); with the hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit), the existence of at_exit will also force switch_toggled.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires at_exit and Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) requires switch_toggled to occur before or at the same time as at_exit. Together, these correctly capture the requirement to reach the exit only after flipping the switch.

texts: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u3
(u1, at_exit) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_exit, u3) -> 11
